description: Full text of a single section (Paragraph) or Art. (Artikel) of a German federal law or ordinance, by abbreviation and provision number, from Gesetze im Internet. Accepts natural forms: "823", "section 823", "823a", "Art 1", "Art. 1". Returns the provision's title, full original-language (German) text, and its own footnote (amendment/application note) when the source attaches one. Annexes (Anlage/Anhang) are read by passing the annex as `provision` plus `item` (one numbered table row, e.g. BKatV item 12.6.1) or `list_items` (the annex's item numbers); without those, an annex answers as one full text. Use for "what does section 823 BGB say", "Art 1 GG" or "what fine does BKatV item 12.6.1 carry". Keyless.

item.description: Optional. A numbered item of an annex table (Anlage/Anhang), e.g. "12.6.1" in the fine catalogue BKatV. Returns that one item with its columns (offence, fine in euros, driving ban) and its numbered parents. If the named annex does not hold it, the law's other annexes are searched.

law.description: The law or ordinance: its official abbreviation ("BGB", "StGB", "HGB", "BDSG", "GG", "ZPO", "EStG") or (if unambiguous) its official title ("Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch"). Call gesetze_search first if unsure.

list_items.description: Optional. With an annex as `provision` and no `item`: list that annex's item numbers with a short heading, paged by `limit` (default 200, max 500) and `offset`.

provision.description: Section/article number as cited: "823", "section 823", "823a", "Art 1", "Art. 20a". With `item` or `list_items`, an annex: "Anlage", "Anlage 2", "Anhang", "Anhang 2".
